public static long move_(@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") DelegatorTileEntity aFrom, @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") DelegatorTileEntity aTo, long aMaxMoved) {if (aMaxMoved <= 0) return 0; FluidStack tDrained = ((IFluidHandler)aFrom.mTileEntity).drain(aFrom.getForgeSideOfTileEntity(), UT.Code.bindInt(aMaxMoved), F); if (tDrained == null || tDrained.amount <= 0) return 0; tDrained.amount = Code.bindInt(fill_(aTo, tDrained.copy(), T)); if (tDrained.amount <= 0) return 0; ((IFluidHandler)aFrom.mTileEntity).drain(aFrom.getForgeSideOfTileEntity(), tDrained, T); return tDrained.amount;}

public static long move_(@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") DelegatorTileEntity aFrom, @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") DelegatorTileEntity aTo, FluidStack aMoved) {if (aMoved == null || aMoved.amount <= 0) return 0; FluidStack tDrained = ((IFluidHandler)aFrom.mTileEntity).drain(aFrom.getForgeSideOfTileEntity(), aMoved, F); if (tDrained == null || tDrained.amount <= 0) return 0; tDrained.amount = Code.bindInt(fill_(aTo, tDrained.copy(), T)); if (tDrained.amount <= 0) return 0; ((IFluidHandler)aFrom.mTileEntity).drain(aFrom.getForgeSideOfTileEntity(), tDrained, T); return tDrained.amount;}

readability.limit: Whitespace, explicit local renames and three evidence-backed comment corrections only. No gameplay changes.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source-derived traces and arithmetic. No compiled classes, target initialization, handlers, worlds or tests executed.

quota.policy: Keep strict quota semantics; do not restore the original underfill bug for lexical parity.

potion_filter.forge_effect_storage: Potion tag via PotionUtils.setPotion; damage getter delegates to IForgeItem Damage tag.
potion_filter.neoforge_effect_storage: POTION_CONTENTS via PotionContents.createItemStack; damage getter delegates to IItemExtension DAMAGE component.
potion_filter.limit: Ordinary distinct vanilla potion variants; no claim all component items fail. Do not require all stack data to match.

rejected_fluid_return.condition: Destination initially accepts and has room. Executed source drain disables subsequent destination filling without deleting stored destination fluid; simulated drain does not. Source endpoint refuses filling. Old fills destination first, then drains and disables further filling; current drains/disables first and loses refused refund.
rejected_fluid_return.limit: Conditional mutable-capability contract; no installed addon or ordinary stable-tank failure reproduced.
rejected_fluid_return.policy: Do not restore fill-before-drain blindly: the original also ignores actual drain failure and can duplicate.

tool_requested_damage.limit: Requested durability before creative/unbreaking/material rules, not guaranteed actual wear per interaction; electric tools excluded from this witness.

ordinary_primitives.items_rejected_on_execute: Already attempts reinsertion and drops any unreturned remainder at source; not the fluid path.
